The season began on 4 January 2015 and finished on 20 September 2015.{{cite web |url=http://english.vietnamnet.vn/fms/sports/118104/v-league-2015-to-feature-14-professional-football-clubs.html |title=V-League 2015 to feature 14 professional football clubs |work=VietNamNet.vn |date=6 December 2014 |access-date=6 December 2014 |archive-date=4 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304123235/http://english.vietnamnet.vn/fms/sports/118104/v-league-2015-to-feature-14-professional-football-clubs.html |url-status=dead }} ==Changes from last season== ===Team changes=== The following teams have changed division since the 2014 season. {{col-begin}} {{col-2}} ====To V.League 1==== '''Promoted from [[2014 V.League 2|V.League 2]]''' * [[Đồng Tháp F.C.|Đồng Tháp]] * [[Sanna Khánh Hòa BVN F.C.|Sanna Khánh Hòa]] * [[XSKT Cần Thơ F.C.|XSKT Cần Thơ]] {{col-2}} ====From V.League 1==== '''Relegated''' * [[An Giang F.C.|Hùng Vương An Giang]] {{col-end}} ===Rule Changes=== In season 2015, a team standing on the 14th position was relegated to [[V.League 2|V-League 2]]. There was no play-off match as usual between team standing on 13th at [[V.League 1|V-League 1]] and the second-position team at [[V.League 2|V-League 2]]. Also, one club was only allowed to register 2 foreign players plus one naturalized player. [[Becamex Bình Dương F.C.|Becamex Bình Dương]] and [[Hà Nội T&T F.C.|Hanoi T&T]] could register one more AFC player due to the qualification for [[AFC Champions League]]. ==Teams== [[Đồng Tháp F.C.|Đồng Tháp]] were promoted after winning the [[2014 V.League 2]] championship, but in November 2014 they decided to withdraw from the league altogether.{{cite web |url=http://english.vietnamnet.vn/fms/sports/115731/dong-thap-withdraw-from-v-league.html |title=Dong Thap withdraw from V.League |work=VietNamNet.vn |date=4 November 2014 |access-date=26 November 2014 |archive-date=12 May 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180512114254/http://english.vietnamnet.vn/fms/sports/115731/dong-thap-withdraw-from-v-league.html |url-status=dead }} They later revered their decision once sponsorship was found to fund the side for the coming season.{{cite web |url=http://vietnamnews.vn/sports/262776/dong-thap-find-sponsorship-for-v-league-return.html |title=Dong Thap find sponsorship for V-League return |work=vietnamnews.vn |date=15 November 2014}}
